maddeler.t: Borrowed from Middle Persian *tūbrak or *tōbrak, found as Classical Persian توبره (tōbra, tūbra, “a huntsman's bag; the nose-bag of a horse”) and Classical Syriac ܛܽܘܒܪܰܩܐ (ṭūḇarqā).
s: Classical Persian توبره (tōbra, tūbra, “a huntsman's bag; the nose-bag of a horse”)
g: a kind of knee high, legging
